Name: Devilish Horns for Halloween
Author: lunightmare
Description:
[size=6][center][b]~ HAPPY HALLOWEEN ~[/b][/center][/size]
[size=4][center]To celebrate this halloween, I'm working on a bundle filled with new halloween and fall inspired crops, but first~ Let's add some demon horns to make it all funnier!![/center][/size]
Simply, go to the mouse's shop and buy the horns you'd like~ All of them for only 50!

[size=3]Of course, we have more than one color!
[list]
[*]Red
[*]Black
[*]Blue
[*]Pink
[*]Purple
[/list][/size]
Have fun with them~ 

(PS: Probably I'll be upadting the new crops tomorrow, so if you have any requests I'll be so happy to hear them!)





[size=5][i][center][b]DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS[/b][/center]

[/i][/size][size=3]· Download the mod in "Files".[/size]
[size=3]· Once downloaded, extract de zip file, it has a folder inside with the name of the mod.
[size=3]· Place it in your "Mods" folder, located in your Stardew Valley folder.[/size][/size]
[size=3]· Run your game through SMAPI.
[/size][size=3]· Have fun![/size]


[i][size=4][u][b]By:  ~ Luna ~[/b][/u][/size][/i]
